comments.value: Got that issue on Windows as well.

details:
With the latest SDK 3.5.0, Avatar upload fails on Unity 2022 macOS Editor (**both** Apple Silicon supported editor and Intel supported editor)

I made the project with the command `vpm new "ProjectName" "Avatar"` after installing the latest templates with `vpm install templates`, and confirmed my project has both `com.vrchat.base` and `com.vrchat.avatars` of SDK 3.5.0.

After clicking "Build & Publishing"  button, the build completes, but publishing ends up failing with four error messages including API errors.
